name: Lantern Pond
description: Lanterns float on a quiet night pond. Pressing one flips it and the lanterns beside it. Light every lantern in as few presses as you like. A new pond each day, or as many fresh ones as you want.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A 5 by 5 pond of paper lanterns. Pressing a lantern flips it and the lanterns directly above, below, left and right of it.
help.goal: Light every lantern. Fewer presses is nicer, but there is no timer and no wrong answer.
howToPlay: Press any lantern. It and its up to four neighbours switch between lit and unlit.
Keep pressing until all 25 lanterns are lit.
Today's pond is the same for everyone today, and remembers your best. New pond deals a fresh one whenever you like.
Undo takes back your last press. Restart puts the pond back to how it began.

controls.action: Jump to the start or end of the row
Reach Undo, Restart and the pond buttons

tips: Work row by row from the top: light each row by pressing the lantern just below any dark one.
Pressing the same lantern twice undoes it, so nothing is ever lost.
You can stop at any time. Your pond is saved and waits for you.
